# Aether — free component source candidate

Acquired from the public [Aether UI kit](https://uiverse.io/ui-kits/aether) through Uiverse’s browser code controls. All eight listed components were accessible without purchase. Each item’s original HTML and CSS editor values were saved as UTF-8 without formatting, wrapping, correction, or other transformation.

This is a review candidate for the résumé owner. It has not been selected or applied to the résumé. No downloaded source was executed locally.

## Scope

This folder contains eight individual free components, not the paid [Aether design-system package](https://uiverse.io/design/systems/aether). It does not include the package’s system.css, DESIGN.md, preview/cover documents, or artwork. Font files and other assets referenced by components have not been fetched or bundled.

## License and attribution

Each component page displayed its own MIT License text, credited “Copyright - 2026 uiverse-astronaut (Astronaut)”. The complete displayed license is preserved separately in every component directory. Retain its copyright and permission notice when using or distributing the source. This report does not extend those component licenses to the separate paid design-system package or unbundled assets.

## Integrity and provenance

- `manifest.json`: source URL, author, collection, acquisition timestamp, filenames, byte sizes, and SHA-256 hashes for all eight components.
- `<component>/SOURCE.json`: item provenance plus the displayed description and attribution.
- `verification.json`: 24 source/license files re-read from disk and verified against hashes of the values acquired from the browser.
- No gated items, unavailable licenses, substitutions, or acquisition blockers were encountered.

Acquisition confirms source availability and preservation; it is not an accessibility, security, or integration review.
